messages:
tara_prod: Kicking off an RFC thread for Private Deployment networking (VPC + on-prem). Goal: agree acceptance criteria and launch checklist for V1. Draft doc: https://redwood/internal/rfc/priv-net-draft (please comment). Need infra/security/SRE/SE sign-off by EOD next Fri.
kevin_infra: Quick Q — are we targeting both VPC-connected private control plane and fully air-gapped on-prem installs in the same milestone?
tara_prod: Prefer to scope V1 to VPC-connected private (customer-managed networking, control plane connectivity optional). Air-gapped will be a follow-up milestone but we should capture requirements now.
sasha_security: From a security perspective must include: TLS mutual auth for control plane, customer-managed KMS/HSM integration, per-tenant audit logs, and documented port+CIDR requirements. Also need acceptance criteria for key handling (no private key export).
mike_se: Customers keep asking for stable egress IPs so they can whitelist integrations. Can we make that an acceptance criterion? If so we need to list supported options (NAT gateway, BYO egress appliance, static SNAT).
kevin_infra: Agreed on egress IPs. Implementation options: 1) Redwood-managed NAT in customer's VPC (requires IAM perms), 2) customer-managed NAT with annotated egress IPs, 3) dedicated egress appliance in Dedicated offering. Each has tradeoffs for ops and billing. We should document recommended pattern.
olivia_sre: Observability and failure modes: must include health-check endpoints, fallback policy to hosted API (configurable), metrics for control-plane latency, and an incident playbook for NAT/peering failures.
sasha_security: Edge case: customers using customer-managed KMS over private link or on-prem HSM — acceptance criteria must specify network paths allowed for KMS calls and required ACLs. Also call out support matrix for common KMS vendors.
mike_se: Another edge case: Direct Connect / ExpressRoute customers want static routing to our control plane. Need to document BGP vs. private link options and an estimated lead time + cost table.
tara_prod: Draft acceptance checklist proposal (high level):
- Control-plane connectivity: mTLS enabled and verified
- Egress: documented and testable stable egress IPs or clear BYO instructions
- KMS: integrate with customer-managed keys, no key export, rotation supported
- Network config: CIDR + route table docs, required SG/ACLs, example CloudFormation / Terraform snippets
- Observability: metrics + logs shipped to customer or retained in Redwood per contract
- Failover: documented fallback and SLO degradation behavior
- Tests: connectivity test suite + demo runbook
kevin_infra: Minor addition: include acceptance tests for cross-AZ and cross-region peering, and verify non-transitive routing won't leak traffic across tenants.
sasha_security: Must include threat model appendix for control-plane hijack scenarios and recommended mitigations (BGP validation, route filters, mTLS cert pinning).
mike_se: Adding a short config example for SEs to show customers:
```
private_deployment:
  vpc_cidr: 10.0.0.0/16
  control_plane_endpoints: ["vpce-0abc1234"]
  nat_option: managed
  kms: customer_kms_key_arn
```
kevin_infra: That example is useful. For implementation notes: control plane traffic should be pinned to a small set of IPs per region (we'll publish CIDR blocks) and we should support explicit route tables + security group templates.
olivia_sre: Launch criteria proposal:
1) Docs + examples published
2) Automated connectivity test suite passes for 3 reference customers
3) Security review and threat model signed off
4) SLOs defined and observability dashboards in Console
5) SE-run onboarding runbook created
tara_prod: Owners: kevin_infra (implementation), sasha_security (sec sign-off), olivia_sre (SRE/playbooks), mike_se (customer templates), tara_prod (PM/launch). Can we schedule a 30m review Wed 11am PT?
kevin_infra: Works for me.
sasha_security: Works.
mike_se: Works.
olivia_sre: I'll add a short preread summary with test case list.
deploy-bot: Deploy preview for branch rfc/priv-net-2026 created: https://ci/redwood/preview/priv-net-2026
tara_prod: Thanks — please add inline comments on the draft doc. I'll capture action items after Wed review and post updated acceptance checklist.
mike_se: Action item: I'll draft the egress options doc + customer-facing whitelist playbook by Tue.
kevin_infra: Action item: I'll prototype static IP publication flow and share terraform snippets before meeting.
sasha_security: Action item: I'll draft the threat model appendix and KMS support matrix.
olivia_sre: Action item: I'll author the connectivity test definitions and demo runbook.
tara_prod: Great — closing thread for now, will reopen with meeting notes. :calendar:
